reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and I always forget pills at home when I travel. A sachet with the capsules already counted fits my bag, and $24.99 for one box is easy to try.
objection: Two capsules every day is still a lot to swallow, and it says made in China. The named lab report helps, but I would want to see that I can actually open it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not open or the batch number on the box did not match it, I would not buy.
